description: This Scala source file defines a utility object for generating synthetic test data for logistic regression models in Apache Spark's MLlib. It includes methods to create RDDs of labeled points with configurable features, labels, and data partitioning, as well as a main method for command-line execution to generate and save such data.

classes.name: LogisticRegressionDataGenerator
classes.description: Object providing methods to generate synthetic logistic regression data as RDDs for testing purposes.

methods.name: generateLogisticRDD
methods.description: Creates an RDD of labeled points with features and labels suitable for logistic regression testing, with configurable number of examples, features, and data partitioning.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line entry point to generate logistic regression data and save it to a specified output directory.
